title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 85
description: Ten questions on Psalms 85: a prayer for revival, and the promise that mercy and truth meet and righteousness and peace kiss.

questions.text: Whose fortunes has Yahweh restored, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "You have restored the fortunes of Jacob."

questions.text: What does verse 2 say Yahweh has done with all their sin?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin."

answers.text: He has written it in a book
He has kept it before him forever
He has cast it into the sea

questions.text: What has Yahweh taken away, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "You have taken away all your wrath."

questions.text: How is God addressed in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "Turn us, God of our salvation."

questions.text: Why does the psalmist ask, "Won't you revive us again?"
questions.explanation: Verse 6 asks: "Won't you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?"

answers.text: That the land may be rich again
That his people may rejoice in him
That the enemies may be ashamed
That the temple may be rebuilt

questions.text: What will God speak to his people, his saints?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he will speak peace to his people, his saints.

questions.text: What may dwell in our land, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

questions.text: Which two have kissed each other in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: "Righteousness and peace have kissed each other."

questions.text: Out of what does truth spring, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "Truth springs out of the earth."

questions.text: What goes before him and prepares the way for his steps?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: "Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps."
